name: com.antonlicht.content-repo
description: Editor tooling for managing a shared content repository via git sparse-checkout, plus an Addressables build, CDN upload, and local-dev-override pipeline. Developers check out only the folders they need, build per-package Addressables bundles, publish to a CDN behind a master manifest, and can test local changes without deploying via AssetDatabase (Fast Mode) or local-bundle overrides.
